play_guide.label: Boss moving: Pinnacle (worst case)'s dashes, leaps and charges
play_guide.play: at most 55% of the fight moving in its own dashes / leaps / charges against Pinnacle (worst case) (an upper bound: each used off cooldown, 0.5 s of travel each, UNVERIFIED; walking is the player's choice and teleports don't count; MECHD3, RESEARCH22 #122); a melee skill can't reach it while it travels: 87,709 DPS at that ceiling, 194,909 with the boss in reach (the headline). Close the gap at once after each dash
play_guide.confidence: theory (an upper bound on the loss; the travel time UNVERIFIED, MECH-D's LOW)

play_guide.label: Armour Broken (up 69% of the fight)
play_guide.play: kept up by the build's own rates 69% of the fight, counted at that share (225,562 DPS were it always up)

play_guide.label: Heavily Stunned 45% of the fight while channelling with your shield raised*
play_guide.play: channelling holds the shield raised and the bar never decays: 0.81 blocked boss hits a second (the 41% that are Blockable, one every 0.51 s; no Evasion while raised, so each builds stun: the manager's ruling), 39% of the bar each on average (Physical 40% of hits, 45% of the bar (60% if Melee); Fire 21% of hits, 45% of the bar (60% if Melee); Cold 15% of hits, 20% of the bar (27% if Melee); Lightning 21% of hits, 17% of the bar (23% if Melee): 0.65 (the game's HeavyStunDamageScalePlayer) x the hit after mitigation / Stun Threshold 3,168, a monster's Physical x2, its Melee x1.33 on 38% of hits), so a Heavy Stun every 3 blocked hits (3.7 s), 3 s each with no attacking, Block or Evasion: 45% of the fight. Releasing early to let it decay costs more time (2 s delay + up to 2 s of decay per bar), so not chosen (MEDIUM); every hit at its type's biggest ordinary hit (a harsh bound; the headline uses the average hit): 55% of the fight. 194,909 DPS with the Heavy Stuns (the headline), 353,184 if none landed. A higher Stun Threshold (Life; Unbreakable, Steadfast; Dionadair's double while raised) or more Evasion (an equal chance to avoid the buildup) cuts them
play_guide.confidence: MEDIUM (the buildup factor is the game's constant; its formula PoB's for monsters)

checks.label: Skill costs sustained
checks.note: regeneration, leech, on-hit recovery, flasks (at the rate charge generation refills them in a boss fight), Recoup of the boss's hits and gains on Block, Life / Mana from kills, Remnants, charms and events at the build's own rates, against the per-second cost. Not counted yet (so the share may be low): recovery on Life when you lose a Spirit Charge, Life when your Trap is triggered, Life / Mana per Remnant's Rage (Sanguine Revelry), all Mana when a flask is Used; Life Recharge (Eternal Youth, Tetzlapokal's Desire: counted in the recovery floor, objective.life_recharge, not here: paying a Life cost likely resets its delay, "Further loss of Life resets this delay", so a Life cost paid more often than about every 4 s leaves it little to pay with; MEDIUM-LOW); recovery-rate modifiers on those per-event amounts; and Energy Shield paying a cost (Runic Ward: Assumptions.ward_paid holds Ward-cost skills to what Ward recovery, Remnants of Kalguur's included, pays for)
